name: omar_haddad
title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
job_desc:
Senior Site Reliability Engineer - Cloudharbor (Dallas / Remote US)
Keep a platform serving 2B API requests a day fast and available.
You will: define SLOs and error budgets with service teams; run and scale Kubernetes on AWS with Terraform; build observability with Prometheus, Grafana and OpenTelemetry; lead incident response and blameless postmortems; automate toil in Go or Python; drive cloud cost optimization.
Requirements: 5+ years SRE, DevOps or infrastructure; Kubernetes in production; Terraform; AWS; strong Linux; on-call experience; Go a plus; CKA a plus.

interview.question: Describe an incident you led and what changed afterward.
interview.answer: We had an outage where the database ran out of connections. I was on call and we restarted things and it came back. After that we added an alert.
